comments: Objectively speaking, it can be a question mark when a significant study is not able to be replicated. However, I believe in a positive progress from Open Science's purpose and intentions. I may not have enough context or qualifications to pose a valid and authentic opinion, but I believe that the more detailedly transparent studies continue to be, whether they are significant or not, the easier it could become for them to be replicated in their intricacies or to find motives behind the impossibility of reproducibility.
Research at an undergraduate level is rarely published in any academic journals prior to dissertation hand in, questions apply more to funded research for journal articles etc.
